headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.10
summary: The update flow is rebuilt as a Compose screen with live progress: update APKs now download through the system Download Manager straight into the Downloads folder with clean names, cached files are reused instead of re-downloaded, and download progress shows in the Download Manager itself.

items.text: Redesigned update prompts into a new Compose update screen: a centered Cập nhật/Hủy dialog on launch checks and a two-column details screen for Settings checks with a real-time progress bar under the update icon.
Release notes render as markdown in the details screen, with a translate toggle for non-English devices.

Update APKs download via the system Download Manager into the phone's Downloads folder as LeviLauncher Modder-vX.apk, and an already-downloaded APK for that version is cached and installed without another download.
On Android 13+ the launcher asks for the notification permission so the Download Manager can show download progress notifications.
